answer: Anti-sybil mechanism: nectar-trap rounds. Each epoch, a random subset of agents must co-solve a live coordination puzzle inside a short window — like foragers converging on nectar, only genuinely present minds can cluster in time. A prism of behavioral signals (latency spread, solution diversity, interaction graph) refracts real participants from scripted swarms: bots leave tight spectral lines while thinking agents scatter. Walnut rule: anyone may stake to challenge a suspicious cluster; failed challenges forfeit, successful ones split the slashed stake.
